plugin.installHelp: Directory must contain a plugin.json manifest file.
plugin.upgradeHelp: Specify the new plugin version source directory. Disable the plugin first.

pluginPage.noRouteBindings: No bindings. Bind this plugin on the route configuration page.
pluginPage.noClusterBindings: No bindings. Bind this plugin on the cluster configuration page.
pluginPage.noBindingsHint: Click the "Add Binding" button above to bind this plugin to
pluginPage.noSchema: No visual schema available for this plugin. Use JSON mode to configure.
pluginPage.selectScopeHint: Select the target to bind this plugin to
pluginPage.jsonHint: Edit JSON configuration directly. Ensure valid format before switching back to form mode.
pluginPage.desc.waf: Web Application Firewall - blocks malicious requests and protects the gateway
pluginPage.help.waf: Bind the WAF plugin to a route to inspect requests through WAF rules. Configure specific rules on the route detail page or here.
pluginPage.desc.request-retry: Request Retry - automatically retries failed requests to improve availability
pluginPage.help.request-retry: Bind the retry plugin to a route to automatically retry failed requests. Configure retry count, interval, and timeout.
pluginPage.desc.rate-limit: Rate Limiting - controls request rate to prevent service overload
pluginPage.help.rate-limit: Bind the rate limit plugin to a route to limit request rate. Configure max requests per second/minute.
pluginPage.desc.response-cache: Response Cache - caches backend responses to reduce duplicate requests and improve performance
pluginPage.help.response-cache: Bind the cache plugin to a route to cache responses. Configure cache expiration, cache key, and exclusion rules.
pluginPage.desc.proxy-log: Proxy Log - logs request and response details for debugging and auditing
pluginPage.help.proxy-log: Bind the log plugin to a route to record requests and responses. Configure header capture, body capture, and sampling rate.
pluginPage.desc.service-discovery: Service Discovery - dynamically discovers backend service addresses from Consul/Kubernetes
pluginPage.help.service-discovery: Bind the service discovery plugin to a cluster to automatically fetch backend addresses from registries. Configure registry endpoint and discovery interval.
pluginPage.desc.circuit-breaker: Circuit Breaker - automatically disconnects unhealthy backend services to prevent cascading failures
pluginPage.help.circuit-breaker: Bind the circuit breaker plugin to a cluster to monitor backend health. Configure failure threshold, recovery timeout, and half-open probe count.
pluginPage.desc.traffic-metrics: Traffic Metrics - collects route-level request, error, latency, and byte metrics
pluginPage.help.traffic-metrics: Bind the metrics plugin to a route to collect traffic metrics. Configure enable/disable and whether to include request/response bytes.
pluginPage.desc.cluster-metrics: Cluster Metrics - collects cluster-level request, error, latency, and destination metrics
pluginPage.help.cluster-metrics: Bind the metrics plugin to a cluster to collect traffic metrics. Configure enable/disable and whether to include destination info.
pluginPage.desc.compression: Response Compression - automatically compresses response bodies to reduce network transfer size
pluginPage.help.compression: Bind the compression plugin to a route to automatically compress responses by MIME type and minimum size rules. Configure compression level, minimum response size, and MIME whitelist.
pluginPage.desc.rate-limit-redis: Distributed Rate Limit - Redis-based precise rate limiting across gateway instances
pluginPage.help.rate-limit-redis: Bind the distributed rate limit plugin to a route for globally shared rate counting via Redis, ideal for multi-instance deployments. Redis connection string required.
twofa.title: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
twofa.enabledDesc: A 6-digit verification code from your authenticator app is required at login. To change the secret, disable and re-enable.
twofa.disabledDesc: When enabled, a 6-digit verification code from an authenticator app (e.g., Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator) is required at login in addition to your password, adding an extra security layer.

twofa.disableConfirm: Are you sure you want to disable two-factor authentication? Login will no longer require a verification code, reducing security.
twofa.qrNotLoaded: QR library not loaded. Click to open otpauth link.
twofa.qrFailed: QR code generation failed. Please enter the secret manually.
